branchName: IEEE Student Branch, R.M.K. Engineering College
tagline: Advancing technology for humanity — from R.M.K. Engineering College, Chennai.
vision: To be a vibrant student community at R.M.K. Engineering College that advances technology for the benefit of humanity.
mission: To connect students with IEEE's global network of societies, publications and professionals; to build technical and leadership skills through talks, workshops and competitions; and to encourage research, innovation and service to society.
objectives: Grow IEEE membership across all departments of RMKEC
Host a weekly webinar series with distinguished speakers from academia and industry
Establish active student chapters of IEEE societies and councils
Support students in publishing research and competing at national and international level

milestones.title: Branch established
milestones.description: The IEEE Student Branch (STB61871) is established at R.M.K. Engineering College under the IEEE Madras Section.

milestones.title: Smart Village Student Centre & new Execom
milestones.description: The IEEE Smart Village Student Centre is inaugurated along with the 2026 office bearers, and a weekly webinar series begins.

address: R.M.K. Engineering College, RSM Nagar, Kavaraipettai, Gummidipoondi Taluk, Tiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu 601 206, India
